reviews.snippet: Very disappointing experience with Rapido. I booked a cab for around ₹202, but after reaching the destination, the driver demanded ₹400. I was in a hurry, so I had no choice but to pay. The worst part is the customer support. I raised the issue, but there is no proper response from anyone. If Rapido cannot control drivers demanding extra money and cannot provide timely customer support, then what is the point of using the app? Extremely poor experience. Rapido

Rapido used to be much cheaper compared to other competitors, and even now the fares are still reasonably priced. One of the biggest advantages is that auto rides usually get confirmed quickly, which is very convenient. However, recently I noticed an issue with fare calculation. If the auto driver takes a longer route than necessary, the ride distance increases and the final fare also goes up. When I suggest a shorter and better route, the driver sometimes says, “The app is showing this route.”

Your service is extremely disappointing. Instead of helping customers, these issues are making the experience feel unfair and frustrating. 1. The pickup location sometimes gets automatically changed by your app without my consent. 2. The fare shown before booking is different from the fare charged after booking. In my experience, the difference is often around ₹20 or more, which is unacceptable when it happens repeatedly. If the fare and pickup location can change without the customer's approv

We were charged twice the rate. What is concerning is that in the transaction history it's showing that we paid the correct amount while we were asked to pay double the amount. Why is it showing so? Shouldn't the app show the exact amount that was paid? At least letting us know that the charge has increased would have been appreciated. This is just unacceptable. Such an unreliable app.

Whenever I book a ride, your app shows a lower fare compared to other apps like Ola and Uber. However, once I reach my destination, the fare is increased. The fare shown in the app at the time of booking should remain the same when I reach my destination. But almost every time, the auto or cab driver charges ₹40–₹50 extra. As of today, I have paid at least ₹400–₹500 extra because of this issue. I have reported this issue multiple times, but I have not received any proper response or resolution

Previously I was experiencing too much speed drive of the riders. After giving rating and upon asking, please drive slowly. Then I was experiencing good service. But recently I am observing, when I am booking a cab for 15-20km, the cab drivers are cancelling the ride for no reason. And cancellations are not for 1-2 time, for one ride I experienced 6 time cancellations and rebooking. it's really frustrating and a waste of time for customers. Also few drivers trying to approach for higher money.

This app is terrible. Drivers often expect more than the booked fare and refuse to accept the ride. It is completely wrong—especially during an emergency or when one is in a hurry—for them to demand an amount higher than what is shown on the app; refusing a ride because they want extra money, even when a tip is involved, is unacceptable. Personally, I didn't like it at all.

I have been using the app for a long time. recently, I booked a ride and completed it but all of a sudden some other ride started to get booked automatically and every time I cancel it, another ride kept getting booked. for one ride, I even got ₹10 waiting charges also. while am typing reason for cancellation, the app gets stuck as well. it was a bad experience.

First of all ride fare is too high in comparison to other apps plus Rapido is encouraging drivers to accept only if additional amount is added on top of that exorbitantly high fare. Moreover drivers accept and cancel rides immediately majority of the times. Sometimes cab moves towards the pickup point after accepting and after reaching the point they cancel which is too much of a waste of time. Not going to use it and will ask friends and family to migrate to other apps. Absolutely useless app.

I have had a very bad experience with Rapido. Whenever I book, some problem or the other comes up, sometimes in the application and sometimes with the rider. Today I tried so hard and I got late but there is a glitch bar in the application. The location was not getting selected and because of this I got very late. And not just this time, it has happened many times that the location is not selected. It is a very useless application, close it. 😡😡😡😡

Although this won't change anything, but adding a 1 star to contribute to its low rating, seems like getting a ride accepted is winning a lucky draw. Almost no one accepts during busy hours, short distances, though it's same across all the apps since it uses a centralised driver registration app, but it would be helpful if these matters are looked into. If getting a ride is almost impossible, you might switch your app into doing some other functions, at least will add value to it.

it is the most useless app- we enter a loc , it changes it midway , prices increase like crazy midway , drivers are so unsafe , it lags every single time , doesn't show the exact location of the driver or how long he's coming . Even on the way can't clearly see what the route is . We chose the end location as something and the app itself changed it and we were getting late for a meeting. There's not one good thing about the app

My rapido account is showing "Account Temporarily Suspended" and I am unable to log in. I request you to please review my account and let me know reason for the suspension of my account. If there was any mistake from my side then I assure you it will not be repeated again. Kindly help me to reactivate my account at the earliest. I already mailed to the support team but didn't received any response

Worst customer service ever. I've been trying to solve an issue for 3 days and they still don't have the time to reply to me. They reply at odd hours or 40 minutes later, when they already have shown me that they have connected me to an agent. It's so annoying. They are not resolving my issue; neither are they saying anything. This one time they called me at 12:30 at night.

Worst app for travelling. I bought the power pass as they stated that I could avail it's benefits but I'm not able to view it. However, my money was deducted and after I raised the ticket they said that they can't do it manually and that I can't use it. Additionally, they resolved the ticket by themselves without asking for any feedback or follow ups.

Recently i was trying to book a rapido from the usual location and it started showing that something has gone wrong and to try again later. Update :- Used to book metro tickets from here, but even that has stopped working. Tried booking thrice, amount deducted all the three times and failed during confirmation. Done with this useless application,gonna delete my account and uninstall it Update:-it's been 30+days,no refund despite writing to them

Today morning I was trying to book an auto, and got a message from Rapido saying there is a problem and cannot book now. So, I booked through another app. However, the booking on Rapido had gone through and the Rapido auto showed up. Your app seems to be having a problem keeping up real time. I ended having a fight with the cab driver. Two days ago the fare on the drivers side showed 10 rs more that what was showing on my app. I ended up paying more that what I had reserved the auto for

I had a very disappointing experience with Rapido. I booked a ride, and the amount was deducted from my account, but I did not receive the ticket/booking confirmation, and I also did not receive a refund. My money was effectively stuck without any proper resolution. I also faced another issue while booking a Rapido ride during heavy rain. The fare was extremely high, and when I tried to raise a complaint, I did not get a satisfactory response or proper assistance. The app needs to improve its

I booked a cab , the price was showing 199, due to some traffic we reached late, at time of payment amount changed in app from 199 to 270. First of all , how can you do this, who are you to decide. If this ride took more time than usual, then it's not my mistake. When this app already knows the traffic on this route then why show less price, you have option to decide price. And second thing I reached late also, I also need compensation, I should give you less money. I will never use Rapido now.

I’m unable to properly avail the Free Ride and other discount offers on Rapido. The app frequently shows a Free Ride offer while booking, but after completing the ride, the fare remains unchanged and the discount is not applied. Also, customer support is not easily accessible when there is an issue. It is difficult to get proper assistance or clarification regarding the offers and fare. Overall, the experience is disappointing and misleading. Rapido should ensure that the offers
